item.name: Get Plan Rates by Group ID

request.name: Get Plan Rates by Group ID

description.content:
Retrieves all temporal plan rates for a specific group, organized by plan ID.
This endpoint queries plan rates by filtering by group_id.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the group to filter by

response.name: Successfully retrieved plan rates organized by plan ID
